rows.lede: uxui is two things. The ui-iteration-loop plugin for Claude Code and Codex, usable today: it improves a web UI in measured rounds, gates every merge and ratchets every measured value. And the specification of a UX search engine that does not exist yet: it would generate the design variants of an ess-ui/1 document, evaluate them with no I/O and search for the best one.
